request_payload.title: Trial of Cannabidiol for Drug-Resistant Seizures in the Dravet Syndrome.

mentions.sentence: CONCLUSIONS: Among patients with the Dravet syndrome, cannabidiol resulted in a greater reduction in convulsive-seizure frequency than placebo and was associated with higher rates of adverse events.

candidates.label: Cannabidiol (plant-derived, pharmaceutical)
candidates.summary: A purified cannabidiol oral solution with an FDA label covering seizures associated with Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: Kv7 potassium channel openers (ezogabine / retigabine, XEN496)
candidates.summary: Drugs that open KCNQ2/KCNQ3 (Kv7) potassium channels, studied in KCNQ2 encephalopathy due to loss-of-function variants.

candidates.label: Quinidine (KCNT1 channel blocker, repurposed)
candidates.summary: An antiarrhythmic drug and partial KCNT1 antagonist tried in KCNT1 gain-of-function epilepsies, with mixed results.

candidates.label: Stiripentol
candidates.summary: An anti-seizure medicine with an FDA label for seizures associated with Dravet syndrome in patients taking clobazam.

candidates.summary: Germline CBL changes cause a Noonan syndrome-like disorder with a predisposition to juvenile myelomonocytic leukaemia.

candidates.label: HRAS-related disorders (Costello syndrome)
synonyms: congenital myopathy with excess of muscle spindles
candidates.summary: Germline activating HRAS changes cause Costello syndrome: feeding problems, loose skin, heart disease, developmental delay and a raised tumour risk.

candidates.label: IDS-related disorders (mucopolysaccharidosis type II, Hunter syndrome)
candidates.summary: X-linked deficiency of iduronate-2-sulfatase makes heparan and dermatan sulfate build up; the neuronopathic form also causes progressive cognitive decline.

mentions.sentence: BACKGROUND: The Dravet syndrome is a complex childhood epilepsy disorder that is associated with drug-resistant seizures and a high mortality rate.
